docs.text:
Cybersecurity Incident

Alliance Select Foods International, Inc. (the “Company”) announced that it has notified the National Privacy Commission (“NPC”) of a recent cybersecurity incident involving certain of its information technology systems at its General Santos facility.Upon discovery of the incident, the Company immediately implemented containment measures, including isolation of affected systems and activation of its incident response protocols. The Company engaged external cybersecurity experts to assist in the investigation and remediation efforts.The Company is conducting a comprehensive assessment to determine the extent and impact of the incident. Based on the investigation conducted to date, the Company has not identified any confirmed unauthorized access to or compromise of affected data, including sensitive personal information of its employees and service providers.The Company has also implemented precautionary measures across the organization and is undertaking system restoration activities. The Company confirms that its critical financial data is properly backed up, and recovery efforts are ongoing.While the incident has caused temporary disruption to certain systems, the Company continues to implement business continuity measures and is assessing the potential impact on its operations. The Company remains committed to protecting the integrity of its systems and the data entrusted to it and will continue to coordinate with the NPC and other relevant authorities. Further updates will be provided as necessary.

Appointment of Acting Chairman

At the meeting of the Board of Directors of PetroEnergy Resources Corporation held on April 8, 2026, the Board approved the appointment of the President, Ms. Milagros V. Reyes, as the acting Chairman during the temporary absence of the Chairman, Ms. Helen Y. Dee. The appointment comes with the authority for Ms. Milagros V. Reyes to sign as Chairman the Statement of Management’s Responsibility for the 2025 Audited Financial Statements.

Matters Approved by Aboitiz Power Corporation's Board of Directors During its March 24, 2026 Regular Board Meeting

Board Environmental, Social, and Corporate Governance (ESCG) Committee Charter: to (a) reflect its revised scope and responsibilities; and (b) change its name to “Board Corporate Governance and Sustainability Committee”; and2.
